name: Field Notes Clip for Blackwing 602 Pencil

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a specialized holder or clip featuring a main cylindrical body on one end with a hexagonal hollow channel running through its center. Extending from this cylindrical end are two parallel flat plates that form a deep slot or clamp. The opposite ends of these plates terminate in small, solid cylindrical beads that run the full height of the part, providing a finished edge and structural reinforcement.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric clip/holder in OpenSCAD with a hexagonal socket on one end and two parallel clamping plates. The design should allow users to adjust parameters such as the pencil radius, wall thickness, height, and length of the plates.
captions.factory: The script imports shapes from MCAD/shapes.scad to utilize the hexagon module. It constructs the main body using a difference() operation, subtracting a hexagon from a union of a central cylinder and two offset cubes that form the parallel walls. Finally, two smaller cylinders are translated to the far ends of the walls and unioned to act as rounded end caps.
